reason: The cited evidence shows that some HEAs are conventional superconductors (E1, E2) and that disorder can influence superconductivity (E3), but none of the passages provide specific support for the mechanistic chain linking local lattice distortions to enhanced phonon modes and increased electron–phonon coupling. The key premises about the microscopic mechanism are therefore unsupported by the cited prior work.
premises: Intrinsic chemical disorder in HEAs produces local lattice distortions.
Local lattice distortions enhance select low-energy phonon modes.
Enhanced low-energy phonon modes increase electron–phonon coupling.
Increased electron–phonon coupling enables conventional BCS-like Cooper pairing.
A controlled intervention can tune local lattice distortions to optimize coupling.
